title: Software Developer - PHP
jobDescription: Job Summary We are looking for a skilled PHP Developer with 3–4 years of hands-on experience in developing, maintaining, and optimizing web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of PHP, My SQL, and modern web development practices, along with experience working with CMS platforms and MVC frameworks. Key Responsibilities Develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications using PHP. Write clean, efficient, and reusable code following coding standards. Design and optimize My SQL database structures, queries, and stored procedures. Integrate third-party APIs, payment gateways, and external services. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues. Collaborate with designers, project managers, and other developers to deliver high-quality solutions. Perform code reviews and ensure best practices are followed. Optimize website performance, security, and scalability. Work with version control systems such as Git. Create and maintain technical documentation. Technical Skills: Strong hands-on experience with Word Press development, customization, and maintenance. Experience building and managing CMS-driven websites using Laravel-based CMS solutions. Familiarity with No-Code/Low-Code platforms for website and content management. Strong knowledge of Core PHP 7.x/8.x and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP). Experience with My SQL 5.7/8.0 and Maria DB 10.x. Good understanding of HTML5, CSS3, Java Script, j Query, and AJAX. Experience with MVC frameworks such as Laravel, Code Igniter, or Symfony. Knowledge of RESTful API development and integration. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS , AZURE Strong experience with Git version control. Understanding of web security best practices. Experience working with Linux-based hosting environments. Soft Skills Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities. Good communication and teamwork skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks. Attention to detail and commitment to code quality. Nice to Have Experience with React.js or Vue.js. Knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with headless CMS architectures. jobDescription:
Location: Mohali Duration: 6 Months (Internship Period) Start Date: Immediate / June 2026 About the Opportunity This program offers a unique blend of learning and career advancement. As a trainee, you’ll gain hands-on experience in cutting-edge technologies across development and digital domains during a 6-month internship. High-performing interns will be offered a full-time position upon successful completion of the internship period. Open Roles
- Software Engineer Intern (Tech Stack – OST Department: PHP Laravel, Word Press, Shopify) – 1 Digital Marketing Intern – 1 Eligibility Criteria Batch – 2025, 2026 Final-year students or recent graduates Branches – For Software Engineer Intern: B.Tech (CS/IT), MCA, MSc IT (Development) For Digital Marketing Intern: Open to all relevant fields (Marketing, IT, Business, etc.) Minimum 60% throughout academics with no active backlog What We Are Looking For
1. Technical Skills: Strong foundation in programming languages such as C, OOPS (for Software Engineer role) Basic knowledge of PHP, Laravel, and understanding of Word Press/Shopify is a plus Proficiency in web technologies (HTML, CSS, Java Script) and databases (SQL/My SQL) (for technical role) Basic understanding of Digital Marketing concepts such as SEO, SEM, SMM (for marketing role) Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, Ads, or content platforms is an advantage
2. Eagerness to Learn: Passion for technology or digital marketing and willingness to explore new tools and techniques Open to feedback and continuous improvement
3. Problem-Solving Abilities: Analytical thinking and creativity to tackle challenges A proactive approach to resolving issues
4. Communication & Collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication skills Ability to work effectively in a team environment
5. Commitment to Growth: Enthusiasm to build a career in IT or Digital Marketing Results-driven mindset with a focus on meeting deadlines and delivering quality work
6. Organizational Commitment: The candidate should be open to giving a commitment of 2 years (including the 6-month internship) What We Offer A structured learning path to transition from intern to full-time employee Mentorship from industry experts Hands-on experience with real-world projects Exposure to technologies like Laravel, Word Press, Shopify or Digital Marketing channels A positive, inclusive, and growth-focused work environment Competitive stipend during internship and a lucrative package post-confirmation How to Apply Submit your updated resume on this job post OR drop resume at hr@softprodigy.com with the subject: “Interested in Software Engineer Intern Position” OR “Interested in Digital Marketing Intern Position” Mention any previous projects, certifications, or achievements relevant to the role Selection Process Aptitude Test Coding Test *(for Software Engineer role) Technical Round (L1) HR + Management Round Required Skills Problem Solving Skills Communication Skills Apply for this job Share with someone awesome View all job openings

title: PPC Analyst
jobDescription: Responsibilities Plan, execute, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and other relevant platforms Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and coordinate ad copy for high-performing campaigns. Monitor campaign performance, budgets, ROAS, CPL, and conversion metrics. Perform A/B testing on creatives, audiences, and landing pages Implement conversion tracking, pixels, and events in coordination with the tech team Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities for continuous optimization. Share regular performance insights and reports with the marketing team Required Qualifications 2–3 years of professional experience in PPC or Performance Marketing. Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager (Mandatory). Strong understanding of keyword research, audience targeting, bidding strategies, and campaign optimization. Understanding of conversion tracking, pixels, and analytics (GA4 preferred). Good communication and collaboration skills. Ability to manage multiple campaigns while meeting deadlines. Good to Have Experience with Linked In Ads, You Tube Ads, or Tik Tok Ads . Understanding of lead generation funnels, remarketing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Basic knowledge of SEO and digital marketing concepts. What We Offer Opportunity to work closely with a collaborative marketing team. Growth-oriented environment with learning and up-skilling opportunities. Competitive compensation based on experience. Interested candidates can share their updated resume and portfolio at tanu_pathania@softprodigy.com Apply for this job Share with someone awesome View all job openings
